title: Studio portrait of US Air Force officer labeled 'McCoy, Howard M.'
description: Sepia-toned studio head-and-shoulders portrait of a uniformed officer with "U.S." collar insignia, an eagle rank insignia on the shoulder, and pilot wings on the chest. A typed label at the bottom reads "McCoy, Howard M. 550A". The print has punch holes at the top and a crease at upper right.
